title: Turkey Taco Skillet
shortDescription: One-pan seasoned turkey with peppers, corn, and melted cheese
subtitle: One-pan seasoned turkey with peppers, corn, and melted cheese
description: Lean ground turkey browns with taco seasoning, bell pepper, corn, and black beans, finished with melted cheddar for scooping into tortillas or bowls.

steps.title: Brown turkey
steps.instruction: Cook ground turkey in a large skillet over medium-high 8–10 minutes, breaking into fine crumbles until no pink remains and edges look lightly browned.

steps.title: Add vegetables
steps.instruction: Stir in onion and bell pepper. Cook 5–6 minutes until softened and onion turns translucent with slightly softened pepper pieces.

steps.title: Season and simmer
steps.instruction: Add garlic, chili powder, cumin, paprika, corn, beans, tomatoes, and salt. Simmer 8 minutes until liquid reduces and mixture looks thick, not soupy.

steps.title: Melt cheese
steps.instruction: Remove from heat, sprinkle cheddar evenly, cover 2 minutes until cheese melts into a glossy layer on top.

steps.title: Serve immediately
steps.instruction: Scoop into tortillas or bowls. Turkey should stay moist with visible corn and pepper pieces throughout each portion.

proTips: Add a splash of lime at the end—acid lifts turkey from bland to bright.
Offer Greek yogurt as a cool topping instead of sour cream.
Double recipe fits two skillets for faster browning on busy nights.
tonightSpread: Warm flour tortillas and shredded lettuce.
leftovers: Taco salad over romaine with crushed baked chips.
Stuffed into bell pepper halves and baked 15 minutes.
whyCrewsLikeIt: High protein, low grease, and one pan to wash. Familiar taco flavors without frying shells.
mealPrepNotes: Pre-measure taco spice blend. Open and drain beans before the call comes in. Station: Use a 14-inch skillet or two 12-inch pans so turkey browns instead of steaming. Station: Add cheese off heat so it melts without oil separating at the edges. Station: Serve straight from skillet to warm tortillas at the adjacent counter.
